correctness.rationale: The frozen example incorrectly calls the optimum a two-character frame for every prime (e.g. it has three characters for p=3). The frozen running description also overstates the verifier: it filters at the predicted size rather than finding the minimum. Complete replacements in /workspace/repairs/1 fix the example, make positivity and nonemptiness explicit, and accurately document a replacement verifier. Rechecked the final theorem: Gram entries off the diagonal vanish precisely at the primitive orders specified by J. Reducing below degree p^(j+1), divisibility by 1+X^(p^j)+…+X^((p-1)p^j) is equivalent to constant coefficients across each digit fiber, since the quotient has degree <p^j. Nonempty branching forces >=p^r leaves, with equality precisely at p or 1 children as specified. The converses use equal numbers of leaves under forced siblings. Products of free choices give E. Above the last free level the tree fills complete residue classes, giving the subgroup p^s; the larger subgroup p^(s-1) would fill all children at the last free level, contradiction. Nested subgroups give equality and uniform orbit size, including the singleton and full-group cases. The repaired example has p characters and the stated counts. I ran the replacement /workspace/repairs/1/verify.py: exact cyclotomic long division and observed minimization over all subsets and profiles at N=2,4,8,16,3,9,5,7 reproduced all counts, stabilizers, orbit counts, and arities. This is a finite diagnostic supplement to the proof.
